title: 深入伊朗营救美国大兵后：特朗普发布会称有人泄密，行动差点失败｜新闻特写20260407
executive_summary: Video discusses a press conference by Trump regarding a rescue operation of American soldiers in Iran, mentioning a potential leak that almost caused the operation to fail.

key_facts: Trump held a press conference about a rescue operation of American soldiers in Iran.
The operation was almost compromised due to a potential leak.
Various officials spoke at the press conference, including the CIA director, the Secretary of War, and the Chief of Staff.
forward_implications: The incident may strain US-Iran relations.
The leak could have significant implications for national security.
The press conference may influence public opinion on Trump's handling of military operations.
